description.value: Tractor Foods is a Vancouver-founded scratch kitchen chain now operating eight locations across Metro Vancouver and Victoria, built around salads, soups, breakfast sandwiches, and bowls made from locally sourced ingredients. The Robson Street spot sits in the heart of downtown Vancouver, making it a practical mid-ride refuel stop for cyclists exploring the city. Pickup orders are ready in under 10 minutes, and the menu accommodates vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free diets.
